path_redaction_note: Machine-specific paths have been sanitized: checkout paths are repo-relative; /example/artifacts/location-N and /example/toolchain are fictional locations scoped to this record. Measurements, revisions, and recorded hashes are unchanged.
baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory. All baseline engine sources checked against git, and both fixture copies checked byte-for-byte before measurement.
updated_engine: Working-tree incremental single-trail cursors through plain WITH projections and filters, retaining constrained indexed neighbor loading
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, fixture and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup.
fixture: A chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop. Depth 10: 11 reachable nodes, 20 reachable edges, 2046 paths. Depth 14: 15 reachable nodes, 28 reachable edges, 32766 paths. The third fixture adds 10000 disconnected nodes with one eligible NEXT self-loop each at depth 10. Two plain WITH stages alias/filter paths and endpoints, then compute length and endpoint ID. All paths survive the filter. Full consumption verifies exact per-depth multiplicity 2^d; first mode verifies one one-hop result. Options allow 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload, retaining default memory limit. Scalar final projections; no final path hydration.
query: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH p AS trail,b WHERE b.id >= 1 WITH length(trail) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint RETURN hops,endpoint
